Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest can spring up whenever church use occurs, possibly centuries later, so the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities voids it and the friend holds fee simple absolute.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s “hitherto” states only a past trend among progressive societies, and the line is commonly misread as a prediction of future legal change.

Q5649.reason: Immediate post-operative care requires measured urine output, so a drainage bag is used rather than a catheter valve.
